name: Stan Ghouls (Bloody Wolf) - Campaign Navigator Layer
description: MITRE ATT&CK Navigator Layer for Stan Ghouls (Bloody Wolf) NetSupport RAT campaign targeting Uzbekistan and Central Asia. Analyzed by Nazarov Zabihullo.

techniques.comment: Spearphishing Link: Email lure with court summons PDF E-SUD_705306256_ljro_varaqasi.pdf
User Execution: Victim manually clicks link and executes malicious JAR
Windows Command Shell: run.bat and SoliqUZ_Run.bat launching NetSupport client32.exe
Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder: HKCU Run key + SoliqUZ_Run.bat in Startup directory
Scheduled Task: schtasks /TN malicious /TR run.bat /SC ONLOGON
Masquerading: Legitimate signed NetSupport binary client32.exe renamed / hijacked
Obfuscated Files: Single-class JAR obfuscation with payload decoding
Environmental Keying: Geofencing payload delivery to Uzbek IP blocks only
Remote Access Software: NetSupport Manager weaponized as C2 trojan
Web Protocols: HTTP/HTTPS traffic to malicious C2 infrastructure and port 1935
Screen Capture: Real-time screen surveillance via NetSupport RAT
Input Capture / Keylogging: Harvesting keystrokes and banking credentials
Exfiltration Over C2: Streaming victim data back to adversary infrastructure
Financial Theft: Primary campaign motivation targeting banking and accounting systems
